title: Clip
description: One scored, Director-approved highlight clip. Canonical shape of the DynamoDB `Clip` item described in .kiro/steering/architecture.md, extended with the fields the AI Director (pipeline/director.py) already produces. See README.md for how this maps to the pipeline's current raw output (out/*/highlights.json, out/*/clips/manifest.json).

jobId.description: Parent Job this clip was produced by.

start.description: Clip start, seconds from VOD start. Pipeline: `start_s`.

end.description: Clip end, seconds from VOD start. Pipeline: `end_s`.

peak.description: Timestamp of the statistical peak inside [start,end]; used for thumbnail extraction. Pipeline: `peak_s`.

score.description: AI Director's 0-100 virality score (post cross-modal validation). Pipeline: `virality_score`. Note: candidates.json/highlights.json also has an unrelated fusion-stage `score` (the raw peak-curve height, not 0-100) — do not confuse the two; this field is always the Director's 0-100 number.

factors.description: Per-modality z-scores from the fusion stage that produced this candidate. Keys come from config/weights.json (chat, audio, speech, visual); `visual` is commonly absent since analysis runs in --visual-mode fast by default.

modalities.description: Which modalities spiked together near the peak (cross-modal validation — a candidate needs >=2 to survive fusion).

keep.description: Director's keep/drop verdict. Always true for a persisted Clip row; kept for audit trail parity with highlights.json.

reason.description: Director's one-line rationale for keeping the clip. Optional, useful for QA/debugging the scoring, not shown to end users.

category.description: Free-text grouping label the Director assigns (e.g. "funny moment", "food reaction"). Drives compilation-mode grouping in the UI.

hook.description: <=12-char on-screen hook text burned into the first 2.5s of the clip (pipeline/render.py). Pipeline only emits `hook_zh` today; `hook.en` is a fast-follow for the English-market export path.

clipKey.description: S3 key of the rendered 9:16 mp4 (presigned-GET by the API). Pipeline's local CLI emits a local path in `file` instead — swap at the Lambda/render layer, not in this schema.

thumbKey.description: S3 key of the peak-frame thumbnail jpg. Pipeline's local CLI emits a local path in `thumb`.
